prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1447; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Conroe, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking space near the main entrance.

Q: What happened as you were leaving the space?

A: I was backing out slowly and I had just started to turn the wheel when another vehicle came down the lane fairly quickly. It hit the rear passenger side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I glanced in the mirror but the other car was partly blocked by a row of parked SUVs. I didn't have time to stop.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes, I have a stiff neck and pain in the upper back. It got worse over the next day or two. I went to urgent care and they diagnosed a neck strain. I've been doing stretches and taking over-the-counter pain relievers.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since then?

A: I have a follow-up scheduled with my primary care physician. I'm also going to physical therapy twice a week to see if that helps.

Q: Did you miss any work because of the injury?

A: I missed a few shifts because turning my head and lifting things hurt. I'm still working, but I'm on lighter duty for now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was moving slowly and I didn't see the other driver coming. I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
